open_obligations.what_is_open: A uniform lower-deviation and affinity calculation for the profiled moving image on every source, box, and intersecting face, with the joint training score for \(A\) and testing score for \(b\), is not closed.
open_obligations.obstruction: The frozen link condition controls singular magnitudes but permits arbitrary output rotations and supplies no tangent-cone stability bound. The legal dense family keeps the operator fixed, so it cannot certify which term of \(r_{\rm train}\) remains after joint profiling.
open_obligations.attempted: The proof decomposed the split distance against its oracle image, retained the exact Gram-metric perturbation, and examined a first-order source-face residual \(-\Delta A h_0\). These give a conservative upper cost but no matching positive joint-law mixture over all active faces.

open_obligations.what_is_open: The exact piecewise minimax radius, active-face scale, transition surfaces, and maximal polynomial dimension exponent remain undetermined.
open_obligations.obstruction: The proved dense converse and finite-sample projection upper bound have different exponents, while the missing profiled operator converse prevents deciding whether either training term is intrinsic. Arbitrary legal output rotations also rule out an unproved output-frequency truncation argument.
open_obligations.attempted: The fixed-support scalar path, a positive DCT dense block, and the fully uniform projection comparison were derived. Balancing only those certified terms gives a bracket and a sufficient dimension range, but does not identify the minimax frontier.

open_obligations.what_is_open: The smallest adaptation factor and a frontier-order joint multiplier calibration over all moving source and box faces remain unproved.
open_obligations.obstruction: The oracle frontier required to define the sharp factor is unresolved, and the projection map is directionally nonregular at active faces. Resampling only the testing fold would omit the training contribution established in the finite-sample decomposition.
open_obligations.attempted: The conservative split projection rule was calibrated by a simultaneous finite-sample event, yielding exact union-null level and an honest lower confidence bound. This does not provide the requested sharp multiplier law or prove minimality of an adaptation penalty.
